title: ASHA calls spelling pseudoscience

tellings.quote: spelling is not a valid form of communication they've called it pseudo science

plain: The American Speech-Language-Hearing Association, the professional body for speech therapists in the United States, is said to have declared that spelling, a method where nonspeaking people point to letters on a board to communicate, is not valid. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about such children, tells Michels the association says "spelling is not a valid form of communication" and has "called it pseudoscience," without naming the statement or its date. Her point is that the field's leading body rejects the very method her film depends on.
